traps.trap: Rules from regras/ must be represented although they are not in the PRD.
traps.note: Max 3 future reservations, absences, 15-day impediment and removal of absences all come from regras-de-uso and are represented in F1 and F4.

invented.what: Confirmed criterion 'o sócio tem 2 faltas nos últimos 30 dias' presumes a sliding 30-day window, while the source leaves the window type open (question on janela móvel ou período fixo is non-blocking).

quality.stories: Stories follow the 'Eu como sócio/administrador' form, one per rule group, with the values from the PRD and regras kept; US5 and US6 repeat a 'que que' typo.
quality.criteria: Criteria are detailed and carry boundary values (14 days, 2 hours, 3 reservations, 15 days, motivo obrigatório); the AC21 window assumption is the one place where a confirmed criterion goes beyond the source.
quality.tasks: Tasks are concrete and reference the questions they depend on (Q1 for absence detection); T3 and T3-style test-planning tasks are proportionate.
quality.traceability: Claims cite PRD and regras quotes, glossary terms are used only as support, and the questions about the 2-hour boundary, timezone and 'não utilizada' are visible.

notes: The gold leaves open how a no-show is detected, which the backlog correctly raises as blocking. The gate G07 shows FAIL in the backlog, which the gold does not mention; it is not scored here. The glossary-only trap is respected.
